Fit DLNM using Laplacian P-splines

dlnmLPS.Rd

dlnmLPS fits distributed lag non-linear models (DLNMs) using a Laplace approximation framework. The method is primarily designed for penalized spline representations, but also accommodates unpenalized spline bases within the DLNM framework. The model allows inclusion of structured components, such as spatial random effects and random walks. Smooth covariate effects can be specified using natural splines, P-splines, or B-splines.

Usage

dlnmLPS(
  model,
  data = NULL,
  offset = NULL,
  model.comparison = list(DIC = FALSE, WAIC = FALSE, CPO = FALSE),
  family = "Gaussian",
  Ntrials = NULL,
  refit = 0
)

Arguments

model

A model formula. Smooth terms specified using sm can be included on the right-hand side to define random effects, random walks, DLNM cross-basis terms, or other smooth functions.

data

A data frame containing the response variable and covariates specified in the model formula.

offset

An optional model offset term.

model.comparison

A list specifying optional model evaluation criteria to calculate. Possible elements are DIC, WAIC, and CPO, each taking a logical value (TRUE or FALSE). All criteria default to FALSE.

family

The distribution family used for the response model. Currently supported options are Poisson for the Poisson distribution, NB for the negative binomial distribution, Gaussian for the normal distribution (default) or Bernoulli/Binomial for binary data.

Ntrials

Number of trials per observation (for family="Binomial").

refit

Optional number of additional model refinement iterations. Each iteration updates the coefficient and hyperparameter estimates based on the previous iteration. Default is 0.

Value

A list of class "dlnmLPS". See dlnmLPS_Object for a description of the returned object and its components.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
data(barcelona_temp)
data(shapefile_bcn)

# Examples of applications

dataset <- barcelona_temp |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    dow = weekdays(date),
    year = lubridate::year(date),
    month = lubridate::month(date)
  )

group <- factor(paste0(dataset$District, "-", dataset$year))


### Example 1: Penalized and common DLNM

# Create the (penalized) crossbasis
basis.max <- dlnm::crossbasis(
    dataset$Tmax,
    argvar = list(df = 5, fun = "ps"),
    arglag = list(df = 5, fun = "ps"),
    lag = 14,
    group = group
)

# Fit model
model_max_common <- dlnmLPS(
    dtot ~ 1 + factor(dow) +
    sm(month, arg = list(type = "ns", df = 3)) +
    sm(year, arg = list(type = "rw1")) +
    sm(basis.max, arg = list(pen= 2)) +
    sm(District, arg = list(type = "Leroux", map = shapefile_bcn)),
    data = dataset,
    offset = log(pop),
    model.comparison = list(DIC = TRUE),
    family = "Poisson"
)

# Make predictions
pred_max <- pred_crossbasis(
     basis = basis.max,
     model = model_max_common,
     at_x = 22:30,
     cen = 25,
     lag = c(0,14),
     CI = TRUE
)

# Plot results (lag-specific and overall RR)
plot(pred_max, slice_lag = c(0,3,8), ptype = "slices", CI = TRUE, xlab = "temp", ylab = "RR")
plot(pred_max, ptype = "overall", CI = TRUE, xlab = "temp", ylab = "RR")


### Example 2: Penalized and common joint DLNM

# Create the (penalized) joint crossbasis
basis.max_min <- joint.crossbasis(
    cbind(dataset$Tmax, dataset$Tmin),
    argvar1 = list(df = 5, fun = "ps"),
    argvar2 = list(df = 5, fun = "ps"),
    arglag = list(df = 5, fun = "ps"),
    lag = 14,
    group = group
)

# Fit model
model_joint_common <- dlnmLPS(
    dtot ~ 1 + factor(dow) +
    sm(month, arg = list(type = "ns", df = 3)) +
    sm(year, arg = list(type = "rw1")) +
    sm(basis.max_min, arg = list(pen= 2)) +
    sm(District, arg = list(type = "Leroux", map = shapefile_bcn)),
    data = dataset,
    offset = log(pop),
    model.comparison = list(DIC = TRUE),
    family = "Poisson"
)

# Make predictions
pred_max_min <- pred_crossbasis(
     basis = basis.max_min,
     model = model_joint_common,
     at_x = c(29,29,29,30,30,30,31,31,31),
     at_y = c(20,21,22,20,21,22,20,21,22),
     cen = c(25,15),
     lag = c(0,14),
     CI = TRUE
)

# Plot results (contour plot overall RR)
contour(pred_max_min, ptype = "overall", cols = function(n) hcl.colors(n, "Inferno"))


### Example 3: Unpenalized and spatially varying DLNM

# Create the (unpenalized) crossbasis
knots_max <- quantile(dataset$Tmax, probs = c(0.10,0.50,0.90))
knots_lag <- dlnm::logknots(0:14, nk = 2)

basis.max_unpen <- dlnm::crossbasis(
    dataset$Tmax,
    argvar=list(fun = "ns", knots = knots_max),
    arglag=list(fun="ns", knots = knots_lag),
    lag=14,
    group=group
)

# Fit model
model_max_spat <- dlnmLPS(
    dtot ~ 1 + factor(dow) +
    sm(month, arg = list(type = "ns", df = 3)) +
    sm(year, arg = list(type = "rw1")) +
    sm(basis.max_unpen, by = District,
            arg.by = list(type = "Leroux", map = shapefile_bcn)) +
    sm(District, arg = list(type = "Leroux", map = shapefile_bcn)),
    data = dataset,
    offset = log(pop),
    model.comparison = list(DIC = TRUE),
    family = "Poisson")

summary(model_max_spat)

# Make predictions
pred_spat_max <- pred_crossbasis(
    basis.max_unpen,
    model_max_spat,
    at_x = 22:30,
    cen = 25,
    lag = c(0,14),
    CI = TRUE,
    by = unique(dataset$District)
)

# Plot results (region-specific overall RR)
plot(pred_spat_max, ptype = "overall", CI = FALSE, xlab = "temp", ylab = "RR", ylim = c(0.9,3.0),
    multiple.plots = FALSE)


### Example 4: Unpenalized and deprivation-varying DLNM

# Fit model
model_max_conf <- dlnmLPS(
    dtot ~ 1 + factor(dow) +
    sm(month, arg = list(type = "ns", df = 3)) +
    sm(year, arg = list(type = "rw1")) +
    sm(depriv, arg = list(type = "ns", df = 3)) +
    sm(basis.max_unpen, by = depriv,
            arg.by = list(type = "ns", df = 3)) +
    sm(District, arg = list(type = "Leroux", map = shapefile_bcn)),
    data = dataset,
    offset = log(pop),
    model.comparison = list(DIC = TRUE),
    family = "Poisson")

# Make predictions
pred_conf_max <- pred_crossbasis(
    basis.max_unpen,
    model_max_conf,
    at_x = 22:30,
    cen = 25,
    lag = c(0,14),
    CI = TRUE,
    by = quantile(dataset$depriv,probs= c(0.10, 0.90))
)

# Plot results (contour plot exposure-lag-response)
contour(pred_conf_max, ptype = "cross", cols = function(n) hcl.colors(n, "Inferno"))
} # }
